summary.one_liner: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll) is a zero-code multi-agent platform where users define agents, workflows, and tasks through YAML configuration and run them from a web console or Python SDK.
summary.what_it_does: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll) lets users build and run custom multi-agent systems by editing configuration rather than writing code, with agents, workflows, and tasks defined in YAML files under yaml_instance/. A visual Vue 3 web console provides a drag-and-drop workflow canvas, a Launch tab for running workflows with real-time logs and intermediate artifacts, and human-in-the-loop feedback. The README also describes a Python SDK (run_workflow) and a PyPI package named chatdev for running workflows programmatically. It ships prebuilt workflows for data visualization, 3D generation with Blender, game development, deep research, and video teaching. The backend is a FastAPI server, and the repo also contains the legacy ChatDev 1.0 virtual software company, which has been moved to the chatdev1.0 branch.
use_cases: generate PNG charts from a dataset
run deep research tasks with multiple agents
prototype simple games with agent teams
run YAML agent workflows from Python scripts
create animated teaching videos with manim
notable: Zero-code workflow definition via YAML configs with ${VAR} placeholders
Visual canvas workflow designer and Launch tab with live logs
Python SDK and PyPI package for running workflows programmatically
Preserves the original ChatDev 1.0 virtual software company on the chatdev1.0 branch
OpenClaw integration via a clawdhub skill
caveats: 3D generation workflows require Blender and blender-mcp
Teach video workflow requires manually adding manim
Requires an LLM provider API key and BASE_URL configured in .env
Default ports (6400) may conflict and need manual changes
